text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Summer training camp. I've finally 
reached... this ocean.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe……is fine. I wasn't forced 
into retirement before the "Takarazuka 
Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still half in doubt. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Thud)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My strength gives out... and I collapse 
onto the sand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having overcome that dark spring, we've 
finally reached summer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Are you in... "cryosleep"?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Did Neo Universe and the others... manage 
to 'wash ashore'?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Surely, this is the place...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She slowly gets up. Neo Universe looks 
somewhat relaxed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A face I had seen countless times. Yet 
seeing such a peaceful expression on it... 
felt like the very first time.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did Neo Universe and the others 
manage to "break through"...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Any trace of 'ABSS' is already...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't feel entirely at ease. However, 
from here on, we enter a completely 
different airspace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I have to verify what kind of place it is. 
Is it still dangerous, or...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... If only we could break free 
from the gravity of "ABSS"...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe has something she wants to 
do.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes, it is—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: “REVE”……。

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to strengthen the connection with 
Zenno Rob Roy. And then—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I want to expand "REEN". —"Known" 
existences, "unknown" existences. Even 
wider."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
So that we aren't swallowed up by the 
“Great King” and the “Singularity.”

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe wants to "create."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: A new universe, together with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her expression is serene. The new life of 
the Umamusume, Neo Universe, is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it all begins right here. From this 
summer sea.
